business_problem: Australian rail freight operator Aurizon wanted to modernize its data warehouse to improve cost efficiency and scalability and enable predictive maintenance.
solution_summary: Aurizon modernized its analytics estate on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Fabric and related services unify streaming, lake, warehouse, and BI capabilities so analysts and frontline teams can query fresher data without stitching together separate products. Power BI then serves dashboards, self-service exploration, and decision support to business users at scale. Transporting goods, moving data Aurizon's fleet of locomotives is over 700 strong, with nearly 400 of those now fitted with sensors that relay telemetry data back to Microsoft Fabric in real time.
